unit-tests.what: Offline hook tests with mocked Jev in a throwaway git repo.

e2e.what: Install the plugin into an isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and drive real Claude Code against a scripted fake model API.
e2e.how: bash tests/e2e.sh  (uses port 8765, override with E2E_PORT)

validate.what: Validate the marketplace and plugin manifests.

stats.what: Summarize this project's Jev decision log.

reinstall.what: Refresh the installed plugin from GitHub after pushing changes.
reinstall.how: claude plugin marketplace update jev-engineering && claude plugin update jev@jev-engineering  (changes the user's global Claude Code install)

none.what: None of the project tools is relevant to this request.
